name: loop
description: Keep executing instructions at a fixed interval in an active Codex CLI session.

interface.shortDescription: Run recurring work in an active Codex CLI session.
interface.longDescription: Loop combines Codex Goal mode with a session-owned background timer to execute, verify, wait, and repeat work while the interactive CLI remains open. It never stops to ask for approval and never ends itself — only the completion rule or an explicit $loop:stop ends a run.
defaultPrompt: Use $loop:loop every 10 minutes to continue the instructions below in this CLI session.
Use $loop:loop hourly to check progress and perform the next safe step while the TUI stays open.
Use $loop:loop to update the interval for the active CLI loop.
Use $loop:stop to end the active CLI loop.
